remarks: Move right in to Riverside! This sunny 3300 sq ft colonial sits at the end of a cul de sac near schools, train station and shopping conveniences. The first floor features a gracious entry foyer with powder room and coat closet. Enjoy the large front to back living room with fireplace, dining room, eat in kitchen and family room with access to the back deck. The second floor boasts a spacious primary suite plus 4 additional bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. On the lower level there is a second family room, laundry room and mudroom with access to the oversized 2 car garage. The flat back yard is a place to relax and play with gentle sounds from the adjacent school fields in the background. A picket fence completes this perfect place to call home!
